description: Données sur les énergies renouvelables 2020-2022 dans la Communauté de Communes Cœur de France is a dataset listed in COEUR DE FRANCE open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Communauté de communes Coeur de France. Diffusion de données sur le nombre de dispositifs d'énergies renouvelables présents sur le territoire de Cœur de France de 2020 à 2022. Ce jeu de données provient d'un export de données développé par Lig'Air pour l'OREGES Centre-Val-de-Loire. Coverage: Cœur de France (Cher). The portal files it under Eau Énergie, Développement Durable. Its keywords are énergies renouvelables, enr, photovoltaïque. The portal shows 228 records. The portal shows 2025-09-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-cc-coeurdefrance-fr-portal.
